sources.title: Unluckkie/K2-Horizon-3.7B-IK-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a highly engineered suite of ik_llama.cpp quants for K2-Horizon-3.7B. We didn't just press the quantize button; we applied a custom layer-wise precision gradient (APEX methodology) + a high-quality imatrix to make this 3.7B model punch way above its weight class on 8GB RAM hardware.
